TIDEGLASS TEST CABINETS — SIGNED SUPPLY AGREEMENT
Parties: Marlow Fen Instruments Ltd. (Buyer) and Copper Wren Fabrication Ltd. (Supplier). Project TG-86. Signed 1 September 2026. Currency: CAD; all amounts include tax.
1. Supplier will supply two test cabinets, A and B. Total price $22,500: $7,500 deposit on signing, $7,500 fourteen calendar days after Buyer's signed acceptance of cabinet A, and $7,500 fourteen calendar days after Buyer's signed acceptance of cabinet B.
2. Delivery and acceptance are separate events. Each cabinet requires Buyer's signed acceptance certificate. Acceptance may record minor work that does not prevent acceptance.
3. If Buyer requests delayed delivery in writing, Buyer will reimburse documented third-party storage at invoiced cost. Supplier must provide its pass-through invoice and the third-party invoice. Payment is due fourteen calendar days after Buyer receives both.
4. The parties may change a payment date or agree a price credit in writing through their authorized representatives. No instalment accelerates automatically because another instalment is late.
Authorized representatives: Buyer's operations lead, E. Lane; Supplier's director, D. Reed.
Signed electronically: E. Lane for Buyer and D. Reed for Supplier, 1 September 2026.

documents.text:
TIDEGLASS TEST CABINETS — ACCOUNT AND STORAGE RECORD
Supplier account extract, complete for TG-86 through 30 October 2026 at 08:30. CAD; tax-inclusive.
Invoice TG-860: contract price $22,500. Original milestone schedule: $7,500 deposit; cabinet A $7,500 due 20 October; cabinet B $7,500 due 6 November. The accounting system's A due-date field has not been updated for correspondence changes.
2 September: $7,500 deposit received and cleared.
8 October: credit note CN-86 for $1,750, approved by both representatives for an agreed price reduction; allocated to the cabinet A instalment.
22 October: $2,750 received and cleared, allocated to cabinet A. No reversal or reallocation.
Open contract balances: cabinet A $3,000; cabinet B $7,500; total $10,500. No further receipts, credits or refunds through this extract time.
Storage documents reproduced in this record: Quay Store Ltd. invoice QS-86 dated 20 October, TG-86 cabinet B, storage 15–19 October, five days at $130 per day, total $650, paid by Supplier on 21 October. Supplier pass-through invoice TG-S86 dated 27 October, $650 at cost, with QS-86 copy. Due-date field: 10 November.
Open storage balance: $650. Total open contract and storage balance: $11,150. The open balance fields do not distinguish amounts currently due from future instalments.

documents.title: Correspondence
documents.text:
TIDEGLASS TEST CABINETS — APPROVALS AND CORRESPONDENCE
6 October 2026, certificate AC-A: Buyer accepts cabinet A. Minor label correction remains; it does not prevent acceptance. Signed electronically by E. Lane for Buyer and acknowledged by D. Reed for Supplier.
8 October, E. Lane and D. Reed signed CN-86: The agreed $1,750 price credit is final and applies against the cabinet A instalment. It is unrelated to the label correction.
10 October, E. Lane to D. Reed: Please hold cabinet B off-site from 15 to 19 October while we clear the room. We will pay documented third-party storage at invoiced cost under clause 3. D. Reed replies: Agreed; we will provide both invoices.
19 October, E. Lane to D. Reed: Please extend the cabinet A instalment to 4 November. We can send $2,750 this week; the rest will follow by that revised date. D. Reed replies the same day: Agreed. The cabinet A balance is now due 4 November; the promised part payment does not change that date. The other payment terms remain as agreed.
20 October: Cabinet B delivered; carrier record says received subject to inspection.
23 October, certificate AC-B: Buyer accepts cabinet B following inspection. Signed electronically by E. Lane for Buyer and acknowledged by D. Reed for Supplier. The cabinet A label correction is also confirmed complete.
27 October, E. Lane to Supplier accounts: Received invoice TG-S86 and the QS-86 copy today. The $650 matches our holding request. We have paid the $2,750 referenced on 19 October. Please update the A due date in your system.
30 October at 10:15, E. Lane to Supplier: I received today's demand email and attachment at 10:10. We accepted both cabinets. Please check your agreed extension and the separate storage payment terms before calling these balances overdue.

documents.title: Demand
documents.text:
PAYMENT DEMAND — TIDEGLASS TEST CABINETS
From Copper Wren Fabrication Ltd. to Marlow Fen Instruments Ltd. Project TG-86. Emailed 30 October 2026 at 10:10.
We credit your $7,500 deposit, $2,750 part payment and the agreed $1,750 reduction. The remaining contract balance is $10,500. Add the documented $650 storage charge: total outstanding $11,150.
You accepted cabinet A on 6 October and cabinet B on 23 October. Our account shows the first acceptance instalment due on 20 October. We therefore regard you as in default and treat the entire outstanding balance, including storage, as immediately payable.
Pay $11,150 by 2 November 2026. If payment is not received by then, we intend to pursue recovery. We do not enclose any further agreement accelerating the instalments. This demand makes no adjustment for the payment-date extension recorded in the 19 October correspondence.
